abbottina-rivularis.name: Chinese False Gudgeon
notes: Item 8: "mengalahkan" for "outcompete" is imprecise; use "mengatasi dalam persaingan makanan" or similar.
Item 5: "batu licin ... yang terhakis air" is awkward for "water-worn rocks"; "batu yang licin dihakis air" or "batu sungai yang bulat" reads more naturally.

aborichthys-elongatus.name: Red-tailed squirrel loach
notes: Item 5: "dasar kaca tangki" adds "kaca" (glass), which the English doesn't say. "dasar tangki" is enough.
Items 1 and 6: the label "Kekerasan air (GH): 5–12 dGH" adds "(GH)" to "Hardness", and the unit is dGH. This is harmless, but "Kekerasan air: 5–12 dGH" is cleaner.

abramites-hypselonotus.name: Marbled Headstander
notes: Item 10: 'Tiada laporan pembiakan dalam kurungan direkodkan' is slightly stiff. 'Tiada rekod pembiakan dalam kurungan' would read more naturally.

acanthicus-adonis.name: Adonis Pleco
notes: Item 7: "lancefish" is left in English; give a Malay equivalent (e.g. ikan belanak pasir / sand eel) or add a Malay term before the English one.
Item 8: "bersifat wilayah" is slightly stiff; "bersifat territorial" or "mempertahankan kawasan" reads more naturally to hobbyists.

acanthicus-hystrix.name: Lyre Tail Pleco
notes: "lancefish" is left in English. Give a Malay name, or use "(sand lance)" in brackets after a Malay term.
"dalam kurungan" (and "dibiakkan dalam kurungan") for "in captivity" is awkward. Use "dalam penangkaran" or "di dalam akuarium", which is what Malaysian hobbyists say.

acanthocobitis-botia.name: Zipper loach
notes: Item 4: 'Ukuran dasar tangki melebihi 75 × 30 cm sudah memadai' — 'in excess of' is rendered awkwardly; better 'sekurang-kurangnya 75 × 30 cm'. The volume '~68 liter' is the converted figure; per the rounding rule it should be ~70 liter. Also use the Malaysian spelling 'liter/liter' consistently.
Item 11: 'sirip ekor yang tajam' for 'pointed caudal fin' should be 'runcing'; 'tajam' means sharp.
Item 11: 'emarginate' translated as 'bertakuk' is acceptable, but 'truncate' as 'rata hujungnya' is fine. 'Kekerasan air (GH)' is fine.
Item 1: 'Sejak sekian lama ia disangka bertaburan' is awkward; use 'Ia sekian lama disangka terdapat dari Pakistan hingga barat Thailand'. 'agak lasak' for 'relatively hardy' is acceptable.
Item 5: 'Walaupun pergerakan air yang tinggi tidak wajib' is stiff; use 'arus air yang kuat tidak semestinya diperlukan'.
Item 3: 'batu kerikil besar' for 'cobbles' is unclear; use 'batu bulat' or 'batu sungai'.
Item 10: 'berkemungkinan memakan telurnya' after 'nampaknya' is redundant; simplify to 'spesies ini berkemungkinan memakan telurnya'.
Item 7: 'ephemeropteran' and 'chironomid' are left untranslated; consider 'larva agas (chironomid)' and 'larva langau-Mei (Ephemeroptera)'.

acanthocobitis-pavonacea.name: Peacock loach
notes: Item 5: 'susunan jenis hillstream ... aquascape berbatu' leaves English terms bare; consider 'susunan jenis sungai berarus deras (hillstream)' and 'aquascape' in brackets or a Malay equivalent.
Item 1: 'mengitar semula air tangki 8–12 kali sejam' is slightly clumsy; 'memutar ganti air dalam tangki 8–12 kali sejam' or similar would be more natural.

acanthocobitis-rubidipinnis.name: Red-finned Loach
notes: "Loach" is left in English; use the local term "ikan loces" or "Loach" with the local term, e.g. "ikan loces (loach)".
"tangki" is acceptable but "akuarium" is the more common hobby term for a fish tank.
"13 1/2 hingga 15 1/2 jejari sirip bercabang" is a clumsy rendering; write it as "13½ hingga 15½" or explain the half rays.
"tangki khas spesies" is awkward; use "akuarium spesies tunggal" or "akuarium khusus untuk spesies ini".
"ikan betina ... berwarna lebih terang" is fine, but "perut yang lebih berisi" slightly shifts "stronger stomach-circumference"; "lilitan perut yang lebih besar" would be closer.

acanthocobitis-zonalternans.name: Acanthocobitis zonalternans
notes: Item 10: 'Andy had recovered a small number of fry from one of his filters' rendered as 'menemui ... di dalam salah satu penapisnya' is fine, but 'kebanyakan telur dimakan' loses the point that the eggs were being eaten (by the adults); say 'dimakan oleh ikan dewasa' only if the source states it. Also 'pergaduhan antara kedua-dua jantan' is fine.
Item 10: 'prolific for a small fish' became 'sangat produktif bagi ikan sekecil ini'. This is acceptable but a bit clumsy; 'agak produktif bagi ikan kecil' would be more natural.
Item 5: 'Weekly water changes' and 'ala hillstream' leave English 'hillstream' and 'aquascape' untranslated. Use 'aliran bukit/sungai berbukit' and 'susun atur akuascape' or add the Malay term first.
Item 5: 'daun kering beech, oak' leaves the tree names in English. Add a Malay gloss, e.g. 'daun beech (sejenis kayu keras)'.
Item 1: 'bermula dari Manipur ... ke barat dan semenanjung Thailand' reads as 'west and peninsular'. Use 'Thailand barat dan semenanjung'.
Item 1 and 4: 'tangki' is used for the aquarium. 'Akuarium' is more consistent with the rest of the text.
Item 4: The volume '~54 liter' is converted correctly, but the spelling should be 'liter/liter' in Malaysian usage 'liter' or 'L'. Keep it consistent with other items.
Item 2: 'jalur ... boleh jadi penuh sepenuhnya' is redundant. Use 'boleh berterusan sepenuhnya tanpa putus'.
Item 8: 'Ia paling selesa bersama spesiesnya sendiri' is vague; use 'paling baik dipelihara bersama sesamanya'.
Item 3: 'tebing' for 'marginal vegetation' is slightly off. Use 'tumbuhan tepian'.

acanthodoras-cataphractus.name: Chocolate talking catfish
notes: Item 10: the source text ends mid-word ('caesews'), and the Malay ends at 'berhenti' without finishing the sentence. The translation is truncated and the final clause is incomplete. Complete it, for example 'berhenti selepas telur menetas', or flag the broken source.
Item 4: 'Ukuran dasar tangki ... 108 liter' is fine. Use the Malaysian spelling 'liter' or 'liter (L)' consistently. 'Isipadu' is acceptable.
Item 1/11: 'Chocolate talking catfish' and 'ikan keli doradid' are fine. For 'sisik keras infranuchal' (scute), consider 'skut' or 'plat tulang (scute)', since 'sisik keras' is awkward.
Item 11: 'lengkungan pelvis' for 'pelvic girdle' would be better as 'gelang pelvis'.
Item 11: 'kononnya' for 'ostensibly' implies doubt about the claim. Use 'dikatakan' or 'nampaknya' instead.
Item 11: 'boleh menembusi kulit manusia' for 'can break human skin' is a little strong. Use 'boleh mencederakan/menyebabkan kulit luka'.
Item 7: 'cacing tanah, sama ada seekor penuh atau dipotong' is awkward. Use 'cacing tanah utuh atau dipotong'.
Item 3: 'hutan paya bakau di pesisir' is OK. 'segenus Acanthodoras spinosissimus' is fine.

acanthodoras-spinosissimus.name: Acanthodoras spinosissimus
notes: Item 10: the English ends mid-word ('caesews', a source truncation). The Malay ends 'berhenti' with no full stop. It is cut off, so the sentence is incomplete and the fact is lost. Flag it and complete or check the source.
Item 3: 'hutan paya bakau pesisir pantai' is clumsy. Use 'paya bakau pesisir'. 'Hutan' is an addition.
Item 3: 'spesies segenus Acanthodoras cataphractus' is awkward. Use 'Acanthodoras cataphractus yang segenus'.
Item 11: 'lengkung pelvis' for 'pelvic girdle' should be 'gelang pelvis'.
Item 11: 'sisik keras' for 'scute' is non-standard. Use 'skut' or 'sisik bertulang'.
Item 11: 'Ini merupakan perubahan besar daripada hipotesis terdahulu' is acceptable, but 'pasangan kumpulan saudara' for 'sister group pairing' is awkward. Use 'kumpulan saudara (sister group)'.
Item 5: 'tangki' appears where the English says 'set-up'. Use 'akuarium' for consistency with the rest of the text.
Item 1: 'Kekerasan air (GH)' labels dGH as GH. Keep it consistent, e.g. 'Kekerasan (dGH)'.
Item 7: 'makanan tablet kering' and 'tidak memilih makanan' are fine, but 'cacing tubifex' should be just 'Tubifex' to match the English trade name.

acanthopsoides-molobrion.name: Dwarf horse-faced loach
notes: Item 11: 'SF member Mark Duffill' became 'seorang ahli komuniti, Mark Duffill' and 'Beliau'; ok, but 'pernah berjaya membiakkan A. sp. A01' overstates, since the English says he recovered a couple of fry, not that he bred the species in a documented way.
Item 5: 'Volume: ~54 litres' is kept as '~54 L'. 54 L is not rounded to the nearest 5 L (the source figure is already metric, so this is minor).

Item 12: 'eye ... fits into the head around 6 times' was rendered as 'diameter mata kira-kira 6 kali ganda dalam panjang kepala'. This adds the facts 'diameter' and 'panjang' and the wording is awkward; use 'muat kira-kira 6 kali dalam kepala'.
Item 12: 'emarginate' was rendered as 'bertakuk sedikit'. The fin is notched or forked, so use 'bertakuk' or 'berlekuk' without 'sedikit', which adds a degree.
Item 12: the diagnostic-character passage 'dorsal origin slightly postmedian ... inserted slightly before to over pelvic-fin origin' is awkward: 'pangkal sirip dorsal... bermula' is imprecise.

Items 2, 6, 9: 'tangki' is used for aquarium; 'akuarium' is the more common Malaysian term. Leaving 'loach' and 'cyprinid' without a gloss is acceptable, but 'territorial' rendered as 'terlalu mempertahankan kawasan' is stiff; use 'terlalu cenderung menjaga wilayah'.
Item 6: 'sluggish waters' became 'perairan yang tenang' and 'high flow rates' became 'aliran air yang terlalu kuat'. The 'terlalu' is added; use 'aliran air yang kuat'.
Item 4: 'hidup berkumpulan dengan saiz kumpulan yang berbeza-beza' is repetitive and awkward.

acanthopsoides-robertsi.name: Dwarf Horseface Loach
notes: Item 12: 'Matanya agak besar, dengan panjang kepala lebih kurang 6 kali diameter mata' – English says the eye fits into the head ~6 times; the Malay is acceptable here, but the snout sentence 'panjang kepala biasanya lebih daripada 2.5 kali panjang muncung' is the reverse of the source's ratio logic; check it. It also contradicts the diagnosis's 'snout 2 to 2.5 in head'.

Item 12: 'pangkal sirip belakang sedikit di belakang titik tengah SL, bermula sedikit di hadapan hingga di atas pangkal sirip perut' is clumsy, and 'bermula' repeats the same idea. Rewrite so it says the dorsal origin is slightly past the midpoint of SL and sits slightly before to over the pelvic-fin origin.
Item 12: 'Spesies-spesies ini ditemui dalam koleksi muzium' – 'these' refers to the four species described by Siebert, but the Malay is ambiguous. 'dikutip' versus 'ditemui' is also inconsistent.
Item 1 and 3: 'dikutip' for 'collected' is a non-standard term. Use 'ditangkap' or 'dikumpulkan'.
Item 12: 'benua kecil India' – use 'benua kecil India' only with care; 'Subbenua India' is the more standard form.
Item 12: 'ikan stres' and 'stres' in items 6 and 12 are acceptable; 'pangkal batang ekor' is fine, but 'peduncle' is left in brackets in one place and not the other, so be consistent.
Item 11: 'seorang penghobi, Mark Duffill' replaces 'SF member'. The named person was kept, but the source-specific membership is dropped; this is minor.
Item 6 and 9: 'dideskripsikan' is Indonesian-leaning. Use 'diperihalkan' (Malaysian).

acantopsis-dialuzona.name: Horseface loach
notes: Item 12: 'slightly forked caudal-fin' rendered as 'sirip ekor yang sedikit bercabang dua' – fine, but 'jejari dorsal bercabang' fine; however 'sirip ekor bercabang dua atau bertakuk dalam' OK. Main issue: 'dorsal-fin origin anterior to pelvic-fin origin' rendered 'pangkal sirip' (base) – should be 'permulaan/asal sirip' (origin), meaning slightly changed.
Item 5: 'Volume: ~243 litres' translated as '~243 liter' – use Malaysian spelling 'liter' is acceptable, but the volume should be consistent; also 'Ukuran dasar... patut dijadikan saiz minimum' fine.

Item 9: 'ideally six should be the fewest' – the Malay says 'sebaiknya sekurang-kurangnya enam ekor' which is OK, but 'seekor sahaja' ('only a single specimen') is fine; no change needed except the reordering weakens the contrast.

Item 3: 'telah dihuraikan secara saintifik' for 'described to science' – use 'dihuraikan secara rasmi/dinyatakan sebagai spesies baharu' for clarity; 'Kecil kemungkinan peratusan yang ketara' is awkward – rephrase to 'Tidak mungkin sebahagian besar (jika ada) ikan dalam pasaran...'.
Item 6: 'daun kering' for 'leaf litter' acceptable; 'powerhead' fine. 'Tidak tahan terhadap pengumpulan' okay.
Item 12: 'Subbenua India' should be 'benua kecil India/Benua Kecil India'; 'Kemboja' fine.
Item 1: 'Kekerasan air (GH)' adds 'GH' label not in source (source says Hardness); drop '(GH)' or use 'dGH' only.

acantopsis-rungthipae.name: Acantopsis rungthipae
notes: "Anak A. rungthipae" is slightly ambiguous; "Juvenil A. rungthipae" or "Anak ikan A. rungthipae" reads more naturally.
"horseface loach genus Acantopsis" is clumsy; use "loach muka kuda (horseface loach) daripada genus Acantopsis".

acentrogobius-viridipunctatus.name: Midnight goby
notes: Item 8: "Semasa musim mengawan" adds 'season'; English 'in breeding mood' means when ready to spawn. Use "Ketika bersedia membiak/mengawan".
Item 6: "tempat pembiakannya akan dipertahankan" is vague/awkward; better "ikan ini akan mempertahankan tempat pembiakannya daripada penceroboh".
Item 8: "inilah asal nama popularnya" is slightly wordy; "yang menjadi asal nama popularnya" reads more naturally.
Item 3: "ia suka sedikit garam ditambah" is awkward; better "menyukai penambahan sedikit garam".

acentronichthys-leptos.name: Acentronichthys
notes: Item 7: "memberikan ancaman yang tersebar kepada subpopulasi" is awkward; use "mengenakan ancaman meresap/tersebar terhadap pelbagai subpopulasi".
Item 7: "di hulu muara Sungai Doce" is imprecise for "above the mouth of the Doce River"; "di sebelah atas/utara muara" may suit better.
Item 7: "centron, duri atau tulang keras" - "tulang keras" is an odd rendering of "spine"; use "duri" only.
Item 3/4/5: "sungai-sungai kecil" for "streams" and "sungai" in item 5 are inconsistent; use "anak sungai" consistently.
Item 4: "Negeri Santa Catarina" and "Negeri Espírito Santo" - "Negeri" for Brazilian states is acceptable but "Negeri" may be replaced with "Negeri/Wilayah" consistently; item 3 omits it.

acestridium-dichromum.name: Green Whiptail
notes: Item 5: “chameleon dwarf sucker cat” is left in English with no Malay rendering. Give a Malay equivalent, e.g. “ikan keli penyedut kerdil londeh”, with the English in brackets.
Item 5: “akar kayu” (driftwood roots) is narrower than the English “roots”. Use “akar” or “akar dan batu”.

Item 3: the type locality is left wholly in English (“tributary of Río Orinoco, 7 kilometers south of…”). Translate the descriptive words, e.g. “anak sungai Río Orinoco, 7 kilometer ke selatan San Fernando de Atabapo”, and keep the place names and coordinates unchanged.

acestrorhynchus-altus.name: Red Barracuda Tetra
notes: Item 14: "sirip ventral" is better as "sirip pelvis" (more standard term).
Item 15: "dihuraikan secara saintifik" is better as "diperihalkan secara saintifik" for a species description.
Item 6: "kawasan yang dinaiki air banjir" is awkward; use "kawasan yang dilimpahi banjir" or "kawasan banjir".

acestrorhynchus-falcatus.name: Red Tail Barracuda
notes: Item 8: "Isi padu: ~2025 liter" is a wrong conversion. The English gives ~2025 litres (~535 US gal), so the litre figure is already metric. Keep it, but "liter" should be the Malaysian "liter"/"L" spelling, which is fine. The bigger issue is that the bracketed inch figures were dropped as intended, so this is not an error.

Item 11: "tidak tinggi nilai pemakanannya melainkan diberi makan dengan betul terlebih dahulu" mistranslates "unless properly conditioned beforehand". It should say the feeder fish must first be given nutritious food (gut-loaded/conditioned), not that they are "diberi makan dengan betul" in a vague sense. Reword to "melainkan diberi makanan berkhasiat terlebih dahulu".
Item 15: "Baki genus ini ... Kumpulan A. microlepis" is fine, but "sirip dubur" and "jejari ventral" are stiff. Prefer "sirip dubur (anal)" and "sirip perut" for "ventral-fin".
Item 15: "Empat spesies terakhir ... dianggap" and "klad" are acceptable, but "kumpulan saudara (sister)" is awkward. Use "kumpulan adik-beradik (sister group)".

Item 9: "mereka stres" — "membuatnya stres" is colloquial. Use "tertekan". Also "tangki yang kitaran nitrogennya belum matang" is fine but "biologically immature" could be "belum matang secara biologi".
Item 12: "Agak aman terhadap ikan yang terlalu besar untuk ditelan" is acceptable, but "rakan setangki" is better written "ikan sekolam/rakan tangki" in hobby usage.
Item 2: "Suatu hari nanti ikan ini akan membesar sehingga lebih kurang 30 cm" is fine; no change needed.

acestrorhynchus-falcirostris.name: Big-eyed Cachorro
notes: Item 5: the volume was left as '~2025 liter'. It should be rounded sensibly, e.g. ~2000 liter. Also write 'liter' as 'liter/L' consistently.
Item 12: 'tiga spesies lain... tidak membesar lebih daripada 100 mm SL' is fine, but 'Menezes (1969) mendiagnosis' is awkward. Use 'Menezes (1969) membuat diagnosis'.

Item 2: 'dengan saiz 320 hingga 350 mm SL, ia membesar jauh lebih besar daripada ahli kumpulan yang lain' is redundant ('membesar... lebih besar'). Use 'mencapai saiz'. 'Big-eyed cachorro (nama dagangan)' adds 'trade name', which the source does not state.

Item 6: 'stres' is informal. Use 'tertekan'. 'Kitaran nitrogennya belum matang' is a loose rendering of 'biologically immature'. 'Penutup yang rapat' loses 'tight-fitting' slightly. 'Tumbuhan akuatik' adds 'akuatik'.
Item 11: 'Dilaporkan bahawa' is a stronger rendering of 'Apparently'. Use 'Nampaknya'.
Item 8: 'dikondisikan' is awkward. Use 'dikondisikan/diberi makanan khas terlebih dahulu' or 'disediakan dengan betul'. 'Pemakan ikan mutlak' is acceptable.

acestrorhynchus-heterolepis.name: Freshwater barracuda
notes: In 1: "diperihalkan secara saintifik" is slightly stiff; "diperihalkan secara saintifik" could be "diperihalkan secara saintifik buat pertama kali" or simpler "dihuraikan" (minor).
In 1: "berdasarkan spesimen dari Peru" slightly rephrases "from Peru" (minor, meaning acceptable).
In 1: source says "both species" though only A. heterolepis and A. microlepis are mentioned; the translation follows this, no change needed beyond optional clarity.

acestrorhynchus-isalineae.name: Striped Barracuda Tetra
notes: Item 5: "sama dari semua ciri yang kelihatan" is awkward; use "serupa pada semua ciri yang dapat dilihat".
Item 11: "berbadan lebih tebal" for "deeper-bodied" is imprecise; "badan lebih dalam/tinggi" is clearer.

acestrorhynchus-microlepis.name: Pike Characin
notes: Item 8: "kebanyakan besar ikan pemangsa" is ungrammatical. Use "sebahagian besar ikan pemangsa" or "kebanyakan ikan pemangsa".
Item 8: "dikondisikan" is awkward. Use "disediakan/dikondisikan terlebih dahulu" or "diberi makanan berkhasiat dahulu".
Item 9: "naluri berkawan (schooling)" is imprecise. "Naluri berkelompok" is the usual hobby term for schooling.
Item 12: "jalur nipis kegelapan" is awkward. Use "jalur nipis berwarna gelap".
Item 5: "~2,025 liter" is overly precise. "Liter" is also less standard in Malaysia than "liter/L" with a space. It is acceptable but could be rounded to ~2,000 L.

acestrorhynchus-minimus.name: Dwarf barracuda tetra
notes: #1 "penghobi akuarium khusus yang memiliki tangki besar": awkward; better "penghobi akuarium pakar/berpengalaman yang mempunyai tangki besar". "Saiz yang didapati" is stiff; use "Saiz tersedia".
#2 "200 liter": Malaysian standard spelling is "200 liter" or "200 L"; fine, but "memerlukan sedikit ruang" understates; use "memerlukan ruang yang agak luas".
#3 "diberi makan ikan umpan": use "diberi makan ikan umpan (feeder fish) bersaiz kecil"; the hobby term "feeder" is commonly used in Malaysia.

#4 "agak aman berbanding pemangsa lain": adds "lain" comparison wording; "pemangsa yang agak aman" is more natural. "aman" is better as "tidak agresif/damai"; "secara berkumpulan" could be "dalam kumpulan".

acestrorhynchus-pantaneiro.name: Pantanal Barracuda Tetra
notes: Item 7: 'Isi padu: ~2025 liter' – a conversion error; 2025 L is a gross figure. It should be rounded sensibly, e.g. '~2000 liter'. The source's ~535 US gal is also dropped, which is fine.
Item 8: 'tangki yang kitaran nitrogennya belum matang' – 'biologically immature' is rendered too specifically. Use 'tangki yang belum matang secara biologi' or 'belum cycle'.
Item 10: 'Seperti kebanyakan besar ikan pemangsa' – ungrammatical. Change to 'Seperti sebahagian besar/kebanyakan ikan pemangsa'.
Item 3: 'Sebagai ahli kumpulan A. lacustris yang mempunyai tompok humeral berbentuk bulat' – awkward; 'tompok humeral' could be explained as 'tompok di belakang penutup insang'.
Item 6: 'kawasan yang dinaiki air banjir' – unnatural; use 'kawasan yang dilimpahi banjir' or 'kawasan banjir'.
Item 14: 'bersaudara dengan yang lain' – ('sister to the rest') is unclear; use 'kumpulan saudara kepada spesies selebihnya'.

Item 4: 'masing-masing di Paraguay, Uruguay, Argentina dan Bolivia' – the order does not match the rivers listed, since Paraná, Uruguay, de la Plata and Mamoré are four rivers to four countries; check the pairing.
Item 1/9: 'tangki yang sudah lama stabil' – 'well-established' is better as 'tangki yang sudah matang'. Also 'Kekerasan air (GH)' adds GH to a dGH value; 'Kekerasan' is enough.

acheilognathus-tonkinensis.name: Rainbow bitterling
notes: #6: "iaitu ikan cyprinid keperakan yang biasa-biasa sahaja" is an added explanation not in the English; remove it or keep only "whitefish" in brackets.

#3: "Pemeliharaan haiwan subtropika ini tidak menimbulkan sebarang masalah" is acceptable, but "Oleh itu" adds a causal link the source does not state clearly. Consider "Ini menjadikan ikan ini jimat tenaga dan mesra alam".
#1: "Rainbow bitterling" is left in English as the common name. Consider adding a Malay form such as "Bitterling pelangi".

acnodon-normani.name: Sheep Pacu
notes: "13.5 cm" uses a decimal point; Malay writes decimals with a comma, so use "13,5 cm".
"sheep pacu" is left in English; add a Malay gloss, or keep it as an English trade name if hobbyists use it that way. The Latin name is not given and should stay unchanged if added.
"panjang piawai tanpa sirip ekor" is a literal rendering; "panjang standard (tanpa sirip ekor)" reads more naturally.

acrochordonichthys-falcifer.name: Acrochordonichthys falcifer
notes: Item 3: "Hidup di anak sungai hutan" is fine, but "bergerak aktif selepas gelap" slightly adds "aktif"; consider "bergerak pada waktu malam" (minor).
Item 10: Reference citation left untranslated, acceptable; no fix needed.

acrochordonichthys-gyrinus.name: Falcate Chameleon Catfish
notes: Items 1 and 8: "ikan sekawan yang lebih kecil" for "smaller tankmates" is wrong, because "sekawan" means shoalmates. Use "ikan lain yang lebih kecil dalam tangki" or "ikan sekolam".
Item 9: "lipatan berisi" for "fleshy flap" is unnatural. Use "lipatan berdaging".
Item 7: "Pemberian makanan secara terus" for "targeted feeding" is vague. Use "pemberian makanan secara terarah" or "disasarkan".

acrochordonichthys-rugosus.name: Asian banjo catfish
notes: Item 13: "lipatan berisi" for "fleshy flap" is slightly awkward; "lipatan kulit berdaging" would read more naturally.
Item 1/15: "liang ketiak" for "axillary pore" is literal; consider "liang aksila" with a short gloss.

acrochordonichthys-septentrionalis.name: Mae Klong Chameleon Catfish
notes: Item 7: "Pemberian makanan secara terus begini" is ambiguous for "targeted feeding". Use "pemberian makanan secara terarah/tepat pada ikan".
Item 9: "lipatan berisi" for "fleshy flap" is awkward. Use "lipatan kulit yang berdaging".

acrossocheilus-beijiangensis.name: Acrossocheilus beijiangensis
notes: Item 1: "131 mm SL" omits the "(5 in SL)" figure; this is fine as a unit conversion, but SL (standard length) is left unexplained. Write "panjang piawai (SL)" or similar.
Items 1 and 4: "ikan siprinid" is non-standard. Use "ikan kyprinid" or "ikan dari famili Cyprinidae", or the local term "ikan kap/cyprinid".
Item 4: "bibir tebal berdaging" for "fleshy" is acceptable but slightly stretched. "Bibir berdaging" is more precise.

Item 5: the reference list is left in English, which is correct.

acrossocheilus-iridescens.name: Acrossocheilus iridescens
notes: "siprinid" is non-standard; prefer "sipirinid" or "ikan dalam famili Cyprinidae (siprinid)".
"terhad di Hainan sahaja" reads awkwardly; use "terhad kepada Pulau Hainan sahaja". The same applies to "terhad di selatan China" in item 4; use "terhad kepada".
"lipatan rostral ada" is stiff; use "terdapat lipatan rostral".
"Sungai Mutiara (Zhu Jiang)" is acceptable, but "sensu stricto" is given twice with the same wording; this is fine, though "dalam erti kata sempit" could be simplified to "dalam makna sebenar".

acrossocheilus-monticola.name: Acrossocheilus monticola
notes: Item 1: "ikan siprinid" is fine, but "Lokaliti jenisnya" is stiff; consider "lokaliti jenis (type locality)" for clarity.
Item 4: "jejari ringkas terakhir sirip dorsal bertulang" is stiff; "jejari keras" or "duri" may be more natural to hobbyists.
Item 4: "mulut di bahagian bawah (inferior)" is fine, but "sarung bertanduk" could be "sarung tanduk".

acrossocheilus-paradoxus.name: Taiwan Banded Barb
notes: Item 5: "aufwuchs" is left as a German term with no Malay gloss; consider adding "(alga dan biofilem berlekat)" or similar for hobbyists.

acrossocheilus-parallens.name: Acrossocheilus parallens
notes: Item 1: "Saiz maksimum: 160 mm SL" — the English gives "6 in SL"; dropping imperial is fine, but "SL" is left unexplained. Consider "panjang piawai (SL)" on first use.
Item 1: "siprinid" is non-standard. Prefer "ikan keluarga Cyprinidae" or "sejenis cyprinid".
Item 4: "anak ikan sahaja" for "juveniles only" is acceptable, but "ikan juvenil" is the more common hobby term.
Item 4: "bibir tebal berisi" for "lips fleshy" is awkward. Use "bibir berdaging".
Item 1: "Ikan ini perlukan tangki yang besar" — use "memerlukan" for more standard Malay.

adontosternarchus-clarkae.name: Marbled Knifefish
notes: Item 5: "most active at dawn" translated as "waktu fajar" — acceptable, but "Knifefishes" generalised; consider "ikan pisau ini" for fidelity.
Item 6: "diberi makan cacing tubifex" is awkward; use "Ikan ini pada asasnya memakan cacing tubifex dan makanan ikan beku" ("pada dasarnya" is stiff).
Item 8: "bahasa Yunani purba" is non-standard; use "bahasa Greek purba".
Item 4: "kimia air" fine, but "tidak cerewet" is slightly colloquial; "tidak memilih" or "tidak terlalu menuntut" is more natural for undemanding.
Item 7: "ikan sespesies" is awkward; use "sesama spesies".

adontosternarchus-nebulosus.name: Ikan Pisau Hantu
notes: "dihuraikan secara saintifik" is slightly awkward; "dikenal pasti/diperihalkan secara saintifik" or "dikenali secara saintifik" is more natural for "scientifically described".

aegla-platensis.name: Ketam Aegla
notes: #1 'hanya terdapat di selatan Amerika Selatan' is fine, but 'tidak banyak melebihi 5 cm' is awkward; use 'jarang melebihi 5 cm' or 'hanya sedikit melebihi 5 cm'.
#1 'Ekornya dilipat di bawah perut' is slightly literal; 'abdomen/ekor dilipat ke bawah badan' reads more natural.

#3 'rehat musim sejuk' is a literal rendering; Malaysia has no winter, so 'tempoh sejuk (winter rest)' would be clearer. The added gloss 'iaitu tempoh suhu rendah' is acceptable but 'terlalu panas' for 'too warm' is slightly strong; use 'terlalu hangat'.
#4 'jentik-jentik nyamuk' for mosquito larvae is fine, but 'artemia' should be written 'Artemia' as in the source.

aequidens-patricki.name: Aequidens patricki
notes: Item 5: "200 liter ke atas" is correct, but the English "rather small tanks of 200 litres upwards" is unchanged, so no fix is needed here. Spelling note only: Malaysian standard is "liter"/"L", which is fine.

Item 7: "Newsletter Extra Minggu Kalendar 23 (3), 2013" leaves "Newsletter Extra" in English. Translate it, e.g. "Newsletter Extra, Minggu Kalendar 23 (3), 2013", or keep it as a proper title with a Malay gloss.
Item 7: "tetapi tersilap di bawah nama" is awkward. Use "tetapi tersilap dikenali dengan nama" or "secara tersilap di bawah nama".
Item 2: "ikan hatchetfish" is redundant. Use "ikan hatchet" or "hatchetfish".

aequidens-tetramerus.name: Saddle Cichlid
notes: Item 11: "A. didema group" copies the English typo; it should be A. diadema, consistent with the later "A. diadema".
Item 6: "air berasid secara mutlak" is stiff and slightly overstated. Use "mungkin wajib memerlukan air berasid" or "perlu dipelihara dalam air berasid".
Item 8: "mungkin dimakan" drops the sense of predation. Use "boleh dimangsa" or "dimakan sebagai mangsa".
Item 3: "boleh hidup dalam pelbagai jenis habitat" is acceptable, but "tasik ladam" is nonstandard for oxbow lakes. Use "tasik ladam (oxbow)" or "tasik tapak kuda".
Item 5: "kitaran nitrogennya belum matang" is a gloss for "biologically immature". It is acceptable, but "belum matang secara biologi" would be closer.
Item 1: "dihuraikan sebagai spesies" for "described" is acceptable. "Dikenal pasti/diperihalkan" is more natural for a new species description.
Item 11: "klad" and "kumpulan saudara" are rough for "clade" and "sister". Consider "kumpulan adik-beradik (sister group)" and "klad (clade)".

afruca-tangeri.name: African fiddler crab
notes: "Dalam tangki": for a crab setup, "akuarium" or "paludarium" is more consistent with the rest of the text ("tangki" is acceptable but less natural here).
"berbatu kelikir": "kerikil" is the more common Malaysian spelling/term for gravel.
"makanan beku": fine, but "frosted" food is better rendered as "makanan sejuk beku" for clarity.
"ketam fiddler": consider the local name "ketam biola" with (fiddler crab) in brackets.

agamyxis-pectinifrons.name: Spotted Raphael Catfish
notes: #11: 'kononnya kerana' suggests a pretext or claim; 'ostensibly' is better as 'dikatakan/nampaknya kerana'.
#11: 'sejenis sisik keras unik yang dipanggil skut infranuchal' adds 'sisik keras'. The source says only 'unique infranuchal scute', so say 'skut infranuchal yang unik'.

ageneiosus-inermis.name: Manduba
notes: Item 7: 'ikan bilis (whitebait)' — whitebait is not the same as ikan bilis (anchovy). Use a more exact term such as 'whitebait' alone or 'ikan juvenil kecil beku'.
Item 7: 'diberi makan dengan betul terlebih dahulu' is vague for 'properly conditioned'. Use 'dikondisikan/diberi makanan berkhasiat terlebih dahulu'.

ageneiosus-magoi.name: Slopehead Catfish
notes: "hilang dalam kurungan" is slightly stiff for "in captivity"; "dalam akuarium" or "dalam penjagaan" reads more naturally.

ageneiosus-marmoratus.name: Bottlenose catfish
notes: #7: "ikan bilis putih (whitebait)" is not quite right, because whitebait is not ikan bilis. Use just "whitebait" or a more accurate local term.
#9: "jauh lebih curam" for "much more acute angle" is slightly loose. "sudut yang jauh lebih tajam/akut" would be closer.

ageneiosus-ucayalensis.name: Duck Catfish
notes: Item 10: "mengurat" (courtship) is colloquial and normally means flirting with people; use "mengawan/tingkah laku pemikatan" or "memikat".
Item 7: "ikan bilis putih (whitebait)" is misleading because ikan bilis means anchovy; use "whitebait" or "ikan bilis/ikan kecil beku" with a clearer gloss.
Item 10: "kurungan" for captivity sounds stiff; "dalam akuarium/penjagaan" is more natural.

ageneiosus-vittatus.name: Ageneiosus vittatus
notes: "karnivor sepenuhnya" is fine, but "Di habitat asalnya" is slightly wordy; "habituation" is rendered as "selepas biasa", which is vague. Use "selepas membiasakan diri dengan makanan mati" or "setelah terbiasa".
"kayu bogwood": consider the more common "kayu hanyut" (bogwood) for Malaysian hobbyists.
"slopehead" is left in English. Consider adding a local descriptor such as "keli kepala landai (slopehead)".

aguarunichthys-torosus.name: Bolt Catfish
notes: Item 1: the English gives '14 in SL' and the translation drops the figure. Converting inches to cm is allowed, but the unit is now just '346 mm SL', which is fine. No change is needed here beyond that.
Item 8: 'Tiada laporan. Belum ada laporan pembiakan.' is redundant and reads as a stilted rendering of 'Unreported'. Use 'Tiada laporan pembiakan.' or 'Belum dilaporkan.'

Item 10: the English says the Aguarun are a Peruvian Indian tribe that lives in Ecuador. 'suku kaum peribumi Peru yang tinggal di Ecuador' is acceptable, but 'Yunani' should be 'Greek' as 'bahasa Yunani' for clarity: 'perkataan Yunani' → 'bahasa Yunani'.
Item 2: 'baru ditemui pada tahun 1986' implies recent discovery. Use 'hanya ditemui pada tahun 1986' to match 'was only discovered in'.
Item 4: 'berkemungkinan tidak perlu' is awkward. Use 'mungkin tidak perlu'. 'ikan ini pemangsa tegar' also lacks 'ialah'.
Item 11: 'kucing liar di hutan' is fine, but 'wild cats of the jungle' is plural and generic. Consider 'kucing liar hutan'.

ailia-coila.name: Ailia
notes: Item 3: 'seorang pengkaji' is fine, but 'Mishra, Abhisek 2023' citation remains while the author is anonymised; acceptable. Real issue: 'bagi kesemua 4 genus yang terdapat di kawasannya' is OK.
Item 5: 'Gray's (1830) ... Malapterus (Ailia) bengalensis' fine, but 'mungkin bentuk latin bagi Kajoli' should be 'bentuk Latin' (capitalise Latin) or 'dilatinkan'.
Item 5: 'nama Assam bagi ikan keli ini' is ambiguous; better 'nama dalam bahasa Assam'.
Item 5: 'Penangkapan yang berlebihan boleh menjadi ancaman' fine; 'tahap penangkapan' for 'harvest levels' acceptable.
Item 4: 'Dalam akuarium' for 'In captivity' is fine; 'ulat mealworm' could use 'ulat sesumbat/mealworm' but acceptable.
Item 1: 'Gangetic ailia' left untranslated as common name; consider adding local name such as 'Ikan keli Ganges' in brackets.
Item 2: 'diperihalkan' is stiff; use 'diperihalkan'/'dihuraikan' more naturally as 'diperihalkan' → 'dihuraikan'.
Item 6: 'Froese, R. and D. Pauly' etc. references left untranslated, which is correct.

ailiichthys-punctata.name: Jamuna ailia
notes: Item 4: "Namun, kemungkinan besar eksploitasi berlebihan merupakan ancaman utama ..., tetapi kerana kekurangan data" has a clumsy double contrast (Namun/tetapi); smooth it.
Item 4: "tahap tangkapan" for "harvest level" is slightly loose; "tahap penuaian/penangkapan" is clearer.
Item 3: "lembangan sungai" is acceptable, but "Ailiichthys punctata" is correct as is. "diperihalkan ... terdapat" is stiff; "dicirikan wujud" or "dilaporkan terdapat" reads more naturally.

akysis-brachybarbatus.name: Tuberculate catfish
notes: Item 5: "any decent fishkeeper" is rendered "berpengalaman sederhana". That adds an experience level the source doesn't state. Use something like "pemelihara ikan yang biasa/mampu".
Item 3: "batu kelikir" is a little odd for "gravel". "kerikil" is more usual.

akysis-ephippifer.name: Akysis ephippifer
notes: Item 3: "tangki" is fine, but the tank dimensions "dalam 30 cm" read awkwardly; "kedalaman/ke belakang 30 cm" or "panjang x lebar x tinggi" would be more natural.
Item 3: "menyorok di dalam pasir" is slightly off for burying themselves; use "membenamkan diri dalam pasir".
Item 2: "Wilayah Phitsanulork" is acceptable, but "Lokaliti jenis" is a bit stiff; "Lokaliti tipe" is more common.

Item 5: "sirip ekor yang bertakuk cetek (emarginate)" is slightly loose; "sirip ekor bertakuk" would be more accurate. "sesungut mandibular dalam" is awkward; "sesungut rahang bawah dalam" is clearer.
Item 5: "kysis = pundi" is acceptable, but "pundi (kandung kemih)" would be clearer.

akysis-hendricksoni.name: Hendrickson's stream catfish
notes: Item 6: "~41 liter" – the source gives ~41 litres; the tank-table rule says an 11 US gal tank is named by size keepers use. 11 gal isn't listed, so ~42 L would be the rounded conversion, and 41 is acceptable. Also use "liter" -> "liter/L" consistently. Minor only.
Item 3: "di tebing Sungai Terengganu" adds "on the bank" – the source says "on the Sungai Terengganu". Use "di Sungai Terengganu".

Item 5: "Airnya biasanya jernih hingga sedikit keruh" – "transparent" is rendered as "jernih", which is fine. However, "sebuah kawasan air tenang (backwater) yang bertenang" is redundant; "stagnant" is better as "bertakung".

Item 8: "Tukar air ... 30–50 peratus" – use "30–50%". "moss" is left in English; use "lumut (moss)". "beech, oak" are left untranslated; use "daun beech/oak (oak: ek)" or keep the English term in brackets.

Item 16: "lipatan berisi" for "fleshy flap" is awkward; "lipatan berdaging" is better. In A. alfredi, "pada jantan lebih pendek berbanding betina" is added from "is less than in females" – acceptable but note the source is ambiguous. Typos in the source ("pelkvic") are corrected – fine.
Item 17: "pembiakan" for "spawning" is fine; "milt" is left untranslated; use "mani ikan (milt)".
Item 14: "mengikut citarasa" -> "mengikut citarasa" should be "cita rasa"; "bahagian bawah tangki" is fine.
Item 1/2/10: the temperature range 16.5–24 °C is kept as given; the "°F" is omitted per the rule, which is fine. Item 2: "Diperihalkan" is acceptable.
Item 4: "Keluasan Kawasan Kejadian (EOO)" is a non-standard term; use "Luas Kejadian (EOO)". "trendnya" -> "arah aliran".

akysis-heterurus.name: Akysis heterurus
notes: Item 5: "cukup berpengalaman" adds an experience requirement. The English "decent fishkeeper" is milder, so use something like "pembela ikan yang baik/biasa".
Item 3: "warna penyamaran" is slightly awkward. "Pewarnaan kamuflaj" or "warna yang menyerupai persekitaran" reads more naturally.
Item 7: "Kawasan Penghunian (AOO)" is a non-standard rendering of Area of Occupancy. "Luas Pendudukan" or "Kawasan Pendudukan" is more usual.

akysis-longifilis.name: Akysis longifilis
notes: Item 12: "kurang pandai berebut makanan" narrows "not especially competitive" to food competition; use a more general wording such as "tidak begitu kompetitif".

akysis-maculipinnis.name: Spotfin Stream Catfish
notes: In #13, 'patut boleh' is awkward. Use 'juga sepatutnya sesuai' or 'juga boleh digunakan'.

akysis-portellus.name: Smallmouth Stream Catfish
notes: #4: 'keadaan yang paling disukai' adds a superlative ('paling') not in the English; the source only says conditions in which they feel very well. Rephrase, e.g. 'keadaan yang membuat ikan keli Akysis berasa sangat selesa'.
#1: 'tidak berbahaya' is fine, but 'Hanya mereka yang mempunyai alahan' should read 'penghidap alahan' for naturalness (minor).
#5: 'Tangki' is acceptable, but 'akuarium' is the more common hobby term (minor).

akysis-varius.name: Variable Stream Catfish
notes: Item 3: "wilayah yang sama nama" is awkward; "wilayah yang sama namanya" reads more naturally.

akysis-vespertinus.name: Akysis vespertinus
notes: Item 11: English has the typo 'body depth at anus 135-16.0 % SL'; the Malay silently changes it to '13.5–16.0%'. Probably right, but flag it for the editor.
Item 1/4: 'Saiz' is acceptable, but 'Ukuran' or 'Saiz' could be used consistently. Also 'liter' is the spelling in item 4, so check it matches the other items.

alcolapia-alcalica.name: Soda cichlid
notes: Item 9: "mensenyawakan" is misspelt; the standard form is "menyenyawakan".
Item 4: "bukan sebahagian biasa daripada persekitaran semula jadi" is awkward; "tidak lazim terdapat dalam persekitaran semula jadi" would be more natural.

alcolapia-grahami.name: Graham's soda cichlid
notes: Item 11: "dalam kurungan" for "in captivity" sounds stiff. Prefer "dalam akuarium" or "dalam penjagaan hobi".

alestopetersius-brichardi.name: Cherry Red Congo Tetra
notes: Item 4: "akuarium bertumbuhan akuatik" is awkward for "planted aquaria"; use "akuarium bertanaman" or "akuarium tumbuhan akuatik".
Item 3: "~108 liter" – the English gives ~29 US gal, which the table sets at 120 litres. Consider stating ~120 liter, or keep 108 if the source figure is meant to be kept.

alestopetersius-caudalis.name: Yellow-tailed African Tetra
notes: Item 4: 'Isi padu: ~120 liter' – the English gives ~108 litres (~29 US gal). Per the tank table 29 gallons = 120 litres, so this is fine, but the 'liter' spelling should be 'liter/liter' consistent with 'L' or 'litre' as used in Malaysia (minor).
Item 4: 'Panjang piawai' is fine, but 'disyorkan' phrase 'adalah disyorkan' is awkward; use 'disyorkan' directly: 'Tapak minimum 120 × 30 cm atau yang setara disyorkan.'
Item 1: 'terusan Irebu' – 'channel' is better rendered 'saluran Irebu' (terusan means a canal); same in item 2.
Item 11: 'lembangan Imo dan Niger' – 'drainages' is better 'sistem saliran'/'lembangan sungai Imo dan Niger'; minor.
Item 11: 'dibezakan ... saudara yang lebih jauh' fine, but 'monophyly ... ditolak dengan kuat' is awkward; use 'ditolak sekeras-kerasnya' / 'kemonofiletikan ... disangkal oleh kajian kemudian'.
Item 8: 'well-researched' rendered 'dirancang dengan teliti' (well-planned); the English means well-researched/thought out, acceptable but 'dikaji dengan baik' is closer.
Item 7: 'flake dan granul' left in English; use 'serpihan (flake) dan butiran (granule)'.
Item 11: 'Géry (1977)... tiada kunci pengecaman terkini' fine; but 'Mbimbi Mayi Muneni' vs 'Munene' – the spelling is inconsistent with earlier in the same item; keep one spelling as in the source.

alestopetersius-hilgendorfi.name: Hilgendorf's Tetra
notes: "diimport" is slightly non-standard; prefer "diimport" -> "diimport masuk" or "dibawa masuk" (minor).
"mengikut emosinya" - "emosi" is a bit anthropomorphic; "mengikut keadaan/perasaannya" or "mood" is more natural (minor).

alestopetersius-leopoldianus.name: Alestopetersius leopoldianus
notes: Minor: "Lake Leopold" left in English; could use "Tasik Leopold" (Lac Mai Ndombe is a proper name, fine).
Minor: "flash" could be "denyar kilat"/"lampu kilat"; "oren" is acceptable but "jingga" is more standard.

alestopetersius-nigropterus.name: African Rainbow Tetra
notes: #7: "well-researched" became "dirancang dengan teliti" (carefully planned). Use "yang dikaji dengan baik" or "dirancang berdasarkan kajian" to keep the sense of research.

alestopetersius-smykalai.name: Blue Diamond Tetra
notes: Item 4: "akuarium bertumbuhan akuatik" is awkward for "planted aquaria"; use "akuarium bertanaman" or "akuarium akuatik bertumbuhan".
Item 7: "ikan keli (catfish)" narrows "catfishes" to the keli; use the broader "ikan berkumis (catfish)" or just "catfish".
Item 3: the volume "~108 liter" is left without the usual tank size; a 29 US gal tank is normally named "120 liter".

alfaro-cultratus.name: Knife livebearer
notes: In 1, 5 and 9, the hobby terms are mostly fine. 'tangki' is acceptable, but 'akuarium' or 'tangki' should be used consistently.
In 9, 'flake' is left in English with no local term. Use 'serpihan' or 'makanan serpai (flake)'. 'microworm' could be 'cacing mikro (microworm)'.
In 1 and 10, 'Knife livebearer' is left untranslated at the start of the sentence. Consider adding a local name such as 'ikan pisau beranak'.
In 4, 'akuarium bertumbuhan' is awkward. Use 'akuarium bertumbuhan' (akuarium tumbuhan air).
In 3, 'kawasan air tenang' for 'backwaters' is acceptable, but the 'both slow and moderate flow' phrasing is slightly loose.

allenbatrachus-grunniens.name: Ikan katak
notes: Item 1: "Freshwater toadfish" left in English with no Malay gloss; consider "ikan katak air tawar (freshwater toadfish)".
Item 5: "dalam hobi akuarium" is fine, but "sesungut terbesar di hujung maksila" is slightly ambiguous; "barbel" is better rendered "sungut" or "misai" consistently.
Item 5: "seratohial" and "dentari" are non-standard transliterations; consider "keratohial" and "dentari/tulang dentari" or keep the Latin term.
Item 2: "dihuraikan sebagai A. meridionalis" is awkward; "diperihalkan" or "dipertelakan" is the usual term for 'described' in taxonomy.

alpheus-cyanoteles.name: Udang Pistol
notes: Item 3: "semua benda" is colloquial; use "semua jenis makanan" or "hampir semua perkara" for handbook register.
Item 1: "Udang ini dikenali sebagai udang pistol" reverses the English emphasis slightly, but meaning is intact; optional rephrase "Udang pistol ialah nama yang diberikan kepada udang ini".

altolamprologus-calvus.name: Calvus
notes: Item 2: "flake pun diterimanya" leaves English "flake" in place; prefer "makanan serpihan (flake)" or "makanan kepingan".
Item 3: "suka mengendap" is a slightly awkward rendering of "lurky look"; consider "nampak seperti pengintai/pemangsa licik".

altolamprologus-compressiceps.name: Compressiceps
notes: Item 5: "ikan teman yang jelas lebih kecil" is awkward; use "ikan lain yang jauh lebih kecil" ("tank mates" is also rendered as "ikan lain dalam tangki", which is fine but wordy).
Item 5: "dikenali kerana tahap agresifnya yang rendah" is stiff; use "bersifat kurang agresif terhadap ikan lain dalam tangki".
Item 4: "beban pencemaran air" adds the idea of pollution; "beban air" or "beban bahan buangan dalam air" is closer to "water load".

Item 3: "berbaring" (lie down) is odd for a fish; use "menunggu" or "bersembunyi" for "lies there on the look-out"; "celah-celah batu" adds "batu" (rocks), which the source does not say, so use "celah".

amaralia-hypsiura.name: Banjo Catfish
notes: Item 1: "much reduced dorsal fin" translated as "sirip dorsalnya yang sangat kecil" – reduced is not the same as small; better "sirip dorsal yang sangat mengecil/tereduksi".
Item 1: "not swim even an inch" became "satu sentimeter" – an inch is about 2.5 cm, so use "seinci pun" or "walau sedikit pun" instead of a changed unit.
Item 11: "slender 2 rayed dorsal fin" – "ramping" is awkward for a fin; use "sirip dorsal yang nipis/kecil dengan 2 jejari".

Item 7: "anak ikan ... daripada spesies ikan lain" is ambiguous, so the eggs and fry could be read as belonging to different sources; clarify as "telur dan anak ikan yang baru menetas daripada spesies ikan lain".
Item 7: "paling kerap nampaknya" is awkward; use "kebanyakannya nampaknya".

amatitlania-myrnae.name: Topaz cichlid
notes: Item 8: "ikan belodok air tawar (goby)" is wrong. Belodok means mudskipper, which is not a freshwater goby. Use "ikan goby air tawar" or "ikan puyu/goby".
Item 10: "mengurat" is colloquial and means flirting. Use "semasa pembiakan/bercumbu (courtship)".
Item 10: "menayangkan dirinya" is awkward for the female's display. Use "mempamerkan diri" or "membuat aksi pertunjukan".
Item 8: "Campurkan ia dengan cichlid Amerika Tengah" is a bit stiff. Use "Boleh dipelihara bersama ... hanya jika".
Item 10: "menjaga anak berdekatan antara satu sama lain" is clumsy. Use "menjaga anak masing-masing berdekatan".

amatitlania-nanolutea.name: Yellow Convict
notes: Item 1 and item 10: "mengawan" for "courtship" is imprecise. It means mating, so use "semasa pacaran" or "semasa proses pemijahan".
Item 10: "di mana ia kekal" is calqued from English. Use "di situ ia kekal" or "dan kekal di situ" instead.
Item 3: "Tiada tumbuhan akuatik yang pernah ditemui" is slightly stiff. "Tumbuhan akuatik tidak pernah dilihat di situ" is more natural.

amatitlania-nigrofasciata.name: Convict cichlid
notes: Item 1 and 11: "one of the most ubiquitous fish" is rendered "antara ikan yang paling banyak ditemui dalam hobi ini". This is acceptable, but "ubiquitous" would read better as "sangat meluas / biasa dipelihara".
Item 10: "aksi mengurat" for "courtship displays" is colloquial and misleading. Use "aksi pemikatan" or "tingkah laku percumbuan".
Item 10: "Sediakan ikan untuk membiak dengan makanan yang pelbagai" is awkward for "Condition the fish". Use "Rangsang kematangan ikan dengan diet yang pelbagai".

amatitlania-sajica.name: T-bar cichlid

ambastaia-nigrolineata.name: Black Lined Loach

amblyceps-arunachalense.name: Amblyceps arunachalense

amblyceps-cerinum.name: Amblyceps cerinum

amblyceps-foratum.name: Torrent catfish

amblyceps-laticeps.name: Amblyceps laticeps
notes: "Lokasi tipe" is a calque; use "Lokaliti tipe" (type locality) as in Malay taxonomic usage.

amblyceps-mangois.name: Indian Torrent Catfish

amblyceps-serratum.name: Amblyceps serratum

amblyceps-tenuispinis.name: Amblyceps tenuispinis

amblyceps-yunnanense.name: Amblyceps yunnanense

amblypharyngodon-chulabhornae.name: Princess Carplet

amblyrhynchichthys-micracanthus.name: Bigeye barb
notes: Item 1: 'Perlu tangki yang besar' is acceptable, but 'Saiz maksimum: 20 cm SL' is fine; however 'dilimpahi banjir' is awkward, use 'dibanjiri' or 'hutan banjir'.

ambystoma-mexicanum.name: Axolotl

ameca-splendens.name: Butterfly Goodeid

ameiurus-brunneus.name: Snail Bullhead

ameiurus-platycephalus.name: Flat Bullhead

amia-calva.name: Bowfin

ammocryptocharax-elegans.name: Ammocryptocharax elegans

amphiarius-phrygiatus.name: Kukwari sea catfish

amphilius-atesuensis.name: Amphilius atesuensis

amphilius-cryptobullatus.name: Amphilius cryptobullatus

amphilius-zairensis.name: Amphilius zairensis

anadoras-grypus.name: Dusky Doradid
notes: Item 2: "banyak di kawasan tertentu" is vague/odd for "locally abundant"; use "banyak secara setempat". Also "tiada ancaman besar" is clumsy; use "tidak menghadapi ancaman utama".

Item 8: "spesies tersebut mempunyai jejari sirip dorsal yang bergerigi" is ambiguous. It should say that A. nauticus has the serrated ray and that this species (A. grypus) is smooth. The English is also ambiguous, so the Malay should name A. grypus clearly, e.g. "spesies ini (A. grypus) licin".

Item 1: "aman terhadap ikan sespesies" is fine, but "omnivor" should be "omnivora" (standard Malay).

anatolichthys-anatoliae.name: Anatolian toothcarp
notes: Item 9: "warnanya jauh lebih biasa" for "much plainer" is unnatural. Use "jauh lebih kusam/ringkas".

Item 11: "berevolusi secara bersendirian" is clumsy for "evolved independently". Use "berevolusi secara berasingan".

anatolichthys-danfordii.name: Danford's toothcarp

anatolichthys-saldae.name: Salda toothcarp

anatolichthys-sureyanus.name: Burdur toothcarp

Item 1: "Burdur toothcarp" has no Malay common name or gloss. This is minor.

anatolichthys-transgrediens.name: Acı toothcarp
notes: #5: "Walaupun untuk pemeliharaan jangka panjang" is awkward. Use "Malah untuk pemeliharaan jangka panjang pun, susunan yang ringkas sudah memadai".

anatolichthys-villwocki.name: Sakarya toothcarp

ancharius-fuscus.name: Vaona

Item 2: 'Timur Madagascar' is acceptable but 'Madagascar timur' reads more naturally.

ancistrus-cirrhosus.name: Bristlenose Pleco

ancistrus-claro.name: Gold Marble Bristlenose

ancistrus-cryptophthalmus.name: Blind Bristlenose Pleco

ancistrus-pirareta.name: Pirareta Bristlenose
notes: Item 1: '156 mm (6.1")' — mm is metric so fine; but 'Least Concern' left in English with gloss — acceptable; consider 'Risiko Rendah (Least Concern)' for natural IUCN term.

annamia-thuathienensis.name: Annamia thuathienensis

anomalochromis-thomasi.name: African Butterfly Cichlid

aphyosemion-campomaanense.name: Aphyosemion campomaanense

aphyosemion-celiae.name: Celia's lyretail

Item 4: "perkataan Yunani" is better as "perkataan Greek" (standard Malay for Greek).

aphyosemion-cognatum.name: Red-spotted Lyretail
notes: Item 2: 'beratus-ratus kilometer ke timur Kinshasa' is correct but 'Congo' vs 'Kongo' is fine; consider 'dikutip' → 'dikumpulkan' for natural collection wording.
Item 1: 'Spesimen jenis' fine; 'killifish' could be given with a local term such as 'ikan killi' for naturalness.

aphyosemion-congicum.name: Congo Lyretail

aphyosemion-decorsei.name: Decorse's Lyretail

Item 1: 'killifish' is not italicised or bracketed; consider 'ikan killifish' with consistent usage.

aphyosemion-elberti.name: Red-barred Lyretail
notes: Item 1: "Red-barred lyretail" left in English with no local gloss; consider adding a Malay descriptor or marking it as a trade name.
Item 1: "killifish" is left in English; it is acceptable as a hobby term, but could be given as "ikan killifish".

aphyosemion-erythron.name: Reddish Lyretail

The imperial figure was dropped as allowed, so this is OK. Items 1 and 2: "lembangan" for "drainages" is acceptable, but "sistem saliran" or "lembangan saliran" is closer to the source.

aphyosemion-gabunense.name: Gabon Lyretail
notes: Item 14: "sama ada ada perbezaan" is a clumsy repetition; rephrase, e.g. "sama ada terdapat perbezaan".

aphyosemion-hanneloreae.name: Hannelore's Lyretail
notes: Item 1: "dekat dengan sempadan Republik Congo" adds "sempadan"; English says close to the Republic of the Congo itself. Use "dekat dengan Republik Congo".
Item 1: "jadi spesies ini mungkin juga terdapat" adds causal "jadi" not in the source; use "dan spesies ini mungkin juga terdapat".

aphyosemion-herzogi.name: Herzog's lyretail
notes: "lembangan Ivindo dan Okano": 'drainages' is better rendered 'sistem sungai' or 'lembangan saliran'; 'lembangan' alone is acceptable but in #1 'anak sungai sistem Ogooué' for basins is slightly loose.

aphyosemion-loennbergii.name: Lönnberg's Lyretail
notes: Item 1/3: "Kekerasan air (GH): 1–5 dGH" mixes GH label with dGH unit; "Kekerasan air: 1–5 dGH" is cleaner.

Item 1: "killifish" left untranslated without a local term; consider "ikan killifish".

aphyosemion-mimbon.name: Aphyosemion mimbon

Item 1: 'diperihalkan daripada satu anak sungai Sungai Mvé' is awkward. Use 'anak sungai kepada Sungai Mvé'.

aphyosemion-ogoense.name: Broken-line Lyretail

Item 9: "ketika berebut makanan" is not in the English ("outcompete"). Remove it or make it more general.

aphyosemion-punctatum.name: Aphyosemion punctatum

"Ikan ini boleh membesar sehingga 4.5 cm panjang": consider the more natural "sepanjang 4.5 cm" or "mencapai panjang 4.5 cm"; the meaning is intact.

aphyosemion-rectogoense.name: Aphyosemion rectogoense
notes: Item 4: "Kononnya, pengarang pertama" – "Kononnya" implies a dubious claim; "Apparently" is better rendered as "Nampaknya" or "Dikatakan".
Item 4: "berhias, selalunya berbentuk lyre" – "lyre" is left untranslated; use "berbentuk lira" or "berbentuk kecapi".
Item 1: "killifish" is fine, but consider adding "(ikan killi)" on first mention for readers.

aphyosemion-striatum.name: Red-striped killifish
notes: Item 11: source spells 'Taxiphylum' but the translation changes it to 'Taxiphyllum'. Keep the Latin name as in the source, or at most flag it as a correction.
Item 5: '~41 liter' for ~11 US gal. The Malaysian spelling is 'liter' or 'liter/L', and rounding gives about 42 L, so check the figure. Minor.

apistogramma-alacrina.name: Apisto alacrina
notes: Item 10: "hyper-aggressive" is rendered as "terlalu agresif", which is a little weaker. "sangat agresif" or "amat agresif" would be closer.

apistogramma-atahualpa.name: Apistogramma atahualpa

Minor: "atahualpa" is a species epithet; could be italicised/kept as is, which is fine.

apistogramma-barlowi.name: Apistogramma barlowi
notes: Item 4: '~54 litres (~14 US gal)' – the 60 × 30 cm base volume was converted to '~54 liter' but a 14 US gal tank should not be given as an exact conversion; check the volume figure and use 'liter' → 'liter/litre' consistently (Malaysian standard 'liter' ok). Item 10: 'mengeram dalam mulut' for mouthbrooding and 'mengurat' for 'courtship' – 'mengurat' is colloquial/wrong register; use 'tingkah laku pasangan sebelum mengawan' or 'pemikatan'.

Item 12: reference list left untranslated – correct.

apistogramma-bitaeniata.name: Apistogramma bitaeniata
notes: Item 7: "Kebanyakannya karnivor dan ... kebanyakannya memakan" repeats "kebanyakannya"; use "Terutamanya karnivor" for "Primarily carnivorous".
Item 9: "dan sirip yang lebih panjang" has no verb; use "dan mempunyai sirip yang lebih panjang".

apistogramma-borellii.name: Apistogramma borellii
notes: Item 10: "Kebanyakannya karnivor dan ... nampaknya kebanyakannya memakan" repeats "kebanyakannya". Use "Terutamanya karnivor" for "Primarily carnivorous".

notes: Item 9: "Kebanyakannya karnivor dan nampaknya kebanyakan memakan" repeats "kebanyakan"; rephrase, e.g. "Terutamanya karnivor dan nampaknya lebih banyak memakan invertebrata dasar".

apistogramma-cinilabra.name: Apistogramma cinilabra
notes: Item 11: "threatened or even endangered" is rendered "terancam atau malah hampir pupus"; "hampir pupus" means nearly extinct, which overstates "endangered". Use "terancam atau malah terancam bahaya (endangered)".
Item 10: "mengurat betina lain" is too colloquial for "courting". Use "memikat" or "mengawani".

apistogramma-commbrae.name: Apisto Commbrae
notes: Item 6: tank is 60x30x30 cm; the 54-litre figure is exact conversion (should be 54 L actually from dimensions) but table says 24 in tank ~ keep; 'liter' should be 'liter/litre' - minor; ok to use 'liter'.
Item 3: 'di bahagian hulu pertemuannya dengan Sungai Salado' is ambiguous/wrong; should say 'di sebelah hulu pertemuannya dengan Sungai Salado' (above confluence) – clarify.

Item 9: 'kutu air (Daphnia, Moina)' – kutu air is a loose term; use 'kutu air (Daphnia)' and 'Moina' separately.

Item 7: 'ikan-ikan ini sensitif terhadap turun naik sisa organik' fine; 'Sudah tentu' for 'It goes without saying' is OK.

Item 4: 'Argentina, Brazil dan Paraguay' fine.

apistogramma-diplotaenia.name: Apisto diplotaenia
notes: "mudah dikenali tanpa silap" is slightly awkward; use "mudah dicam" or "tidak mungkin dikelirukan dengan spesies lain".

apistogramma-elizabethae.name: Apistogramma elizabethae

#11: "setiap rusuk" for "each flank" is slightly odd; "setiap sisi badan" is more natural.

apistogramma-eunotus.name: Apisto eunotus
notes: #11: "bertelur pada permukaan" is ambiguous and could read as the water surface. Use "pembiak substrat" or "bertelur pada dasar/substrat" for "substrate spawner".

apistogramma-gephyra.name: Apistogramma gephyra

apistogramma-gibbiceps.name: Apistogramma gibbiceps

Item 12: "induk berkepala kuning" for "yellow-headed ancestors"; "induk" means parent, so use "nenek moyang" or "keturunan terdahulu".

Item 1: "sebenarnya" in "mengandungi tiga spesies" is not in the English; remove it.

apistogramma-hoignei.name: Apistogramma hoignei

apistogramma-hongsloi.name: Apistogramma hongsloi
notes: #7: "Kebanyakannya karnivor, dan ... kebanyakannya memakan" repeats "kebanyakannya"; use "Terutamanya karnivor" for "Primarily carnivorous".

apistogramma-iniridae.name: Apistogramma iniridae

apistogramma-macmasteri.name: Apisto macmasteri

apistogramma-megaptera.name: Apistogramma megaptera
notes: "bahasa Yunani kuno" is better written "bahasa Greek purba" (the usual Malaysian term); "Yunani" is Indonesian usage.

apistogramma-mendezi.name: Apisto mendezi

apistogramma-nijsseni.name: Apisto Panda

apistogramma-norberti.name: Apistogramma norberti

apistogramma-panduro.name: Apistogramma panduro

apistogramma-paulmuelleri.name: Apistogramma paulmuelleri

betta-pugnax.name: Penang betta

Item 1/8: 'bukan antara ahli genus yang lebih agresif' is stiff; use 'bukan antara spesies yang lebih agresif dalam genus ini'.

betta-splendens.name: ikan laga

boraras-brigittae.name: Chili Rasbora

boraras-maculatus.name: Dwarf Rasbora
